extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers and panel members assessing STFC (UKRI) grant proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for conducting independent peer review of STFC research grant proposals, covering who should assess proposals, the assessment process, nominated reviewer rules, applicant responses, and consideration of animal use in research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment by appropriate experts
rubrics_metrics.description: The assessment of research grant proposals is made by appropriate experts drawn from academia, government and industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select assessors with relevant expertise from a mix of sectors (academia, government, industry) appropriate to the proposal's subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment process: individual review then panel
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals are usually assessed first by individual reviewers and then by peer review panels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual assessments feed into panel discussion and decision-making; reviewers should therefore provide clear individual evaluations that panels can consider.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of individual reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Normally at least two individual reviewers are used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure at least two independent individual reviews are completed for a proposal; one reviewer may be nominated by the applicant (subject to restrictions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Nominated reviewer restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: One reviewer may be nominated by the applicant, although the Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC) reserves the right not to use nominated reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominated reviewers must not be collaborators and should not be from the applicant’s or collaborator’s organisation; STFC may decline to use a nominated reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant opportunity to respond
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are given an opportunity to respond to reviewer comments prior to assessment by the peer review panel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow applicants a chance to reply to reviewer comments before the panel meets so the panel can consider applicant clarifications or rebuttals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of UKRI position on use of animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Animal usage is not something STFC routinely asks reviewers or panel members to assess but it is important that the UKRI position is recognised by our assessors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should be aware of UKRI's position statement and ensure any work involving animals aligns with UK legislation and UKRI guiding principles; consult the UKRI animal-usage guidance where relevant.
